The structure of Al3Co is cubic with space group F-43m (No. 216) and a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Al12Co4) across two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Al centers with 12 geometric neighbors (8 Al, 4 Co) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Co centers have 16 neighbors (12 Al, 4 Co) in a body-centered-cubic-like arrangement. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3D component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Al 12-vertex polyhedra and between Co 16-vertex polyhedra, plus edge-sharing between Al and Co polyhedra.
